jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Toronto or Waterloo, hybrid | Full-time | Reports to the CEO

Build the finance function at a fast-growing senior care technology company shipping hardware to 24 countries.

The Company

We went from a lab in Waterloo to 24 countries in five years. Our sensors detect falls and track sleep, health and wellness, with no cameras, wearables or pendants. Families get peace of mind. Older adults keep their independence. Our CTO, Dr. Yihong Qi, holds 680 patents, and the next few hundred get built here.

Why now

We are scaling. One of the largest deals in our history is in delivery, our consumer product launches in January, and we are preparing our next raise. Every one of those runs on numbers leadership can trust: a close that lands on time, a forecast that ties sales to inventory and cash, and books that hold up in diligence. This is the moment to bring in the leader who owns it.

The role

This is the senior finance role at Pontosense. You own the close, the forecast, controls and the numbers behind our next raise, across our entities in Canada and China. You work directly with the CEO and the leadership team, and you are in the room with investors. This is a builder role first and an operator role second. You set up how finance runs here, then you run it.

What You'll Own

A monthly close that is reliable and consolidated across Canada and China, landing by business day 10
A forecast the company actually runs on, with sales, inventory and cash tied together
Product costing that is right: landed cost, COGS and inventory planning for hardware built overseas
The raise: the model, the data room and investor reporting, with you in the room
Annual financials prepared and audited on time, and the relationships with our auditors and tax advisors
Controls that hold up across two countries: approvals, spend and intercompany
A seat at the leadership table

What Year One Looks Like

The books close on time every month, consolidated. The forecast is trusted, and inventory is planned, not guessed. Audited financials are current, and our next raise runs on numbers that hold up in diligence.

How We Work

Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.
Say it as it is. Kind and direct, at every level, including the CEO.
Real impact. There is more room to make a difference here than at a company ten times our size.
Do what you said. Trust is built on follow-through, and we return it with real ownership.
Hard, and worth it. What we build keeps someone's parent safe at home. Rest well, it's part of the job.

This is for you if

You'd rather own a problem than be assigned a task
You want the mission to matter and the pace to be real
You're happy to be the person who just fixes it

This isn't for you if

You want a playbook handed to you
You need a big team before you can move

You'll thrive here if

You are a CPA who started in audit, then grew with a product or technology company, with promotions along the way
You have owned the close and built the model yourself, not just reviewed them
You have run FP&A, not only the close: budgets, forecasts and the model leadership makes decisions on
You have worked with inventory, COGS and supply chain costing. Multi-entity or international consolidation is a strong plus
You have worked with investors, a board or lenders, or are ready to step into that
You explain the numbers plainly to people outside finance, and decide with incomplete information
You are as happy reconciling an account yourself as setting the strategy

You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

Where this goes

As we raise and scale, this role grows into leading a finance team of your own.

What You Get

A sensor for your parents, on us
Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
Fair pay, with the opportunity for equity
Impact decides your pay and your path, not tenure
Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
Health, dental and vision benefits

The details

Pay: $160,000 to $190,000 CAD base salary
This is a new role, created to grow the team, not a backfill
How we hire: typically an initial interview, a short case, and a final interview in person with our CEO and members of the team. We may adjust this depending on the role
We leverage AI tools in our hiring process, but prioritize human input and manual review

Our Commitment

At Pontosense, we are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and accessible to all. We value diversity and believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to make the necessary accommodations to ensure a fair and positive experience for all applicants.

We strive to provide accessible communication and technology for our employees and customers and always look for ways to improve. If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve accessibility in our workplace, please don't hesitate to contact us.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for open positions at our company.

jobs.title: Finance Director
jobs.description:
Location: Toronto- Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

Yonge-Eglinton

Department: Finance

Status: Full-Time Permanent

Salary Range: $140,000-$150,000 annually

This role supports the healthcare brands across the FH Health portfolio (Pollin Fertility, Perennial and Wellness Haus). FH Health was founded by tech entrepreneurs to support Canada’s pandemic response with innovative healthcare solutions. We’ve since evolved into a leading health-tech company that transforms traditional clinic experiences by integrating diagnostics and care through technology. We are proud to support a portfolio of healthcare brands:

Pollin Fertility-A next-generation fertility centre revolutionizing patient experience, safety, and outcomes through advanced technology.
Perennial – Integrated primary and wellness care brought directly to retirement residences, improving seniors' health and quality of life.
Wellness Haus – A physician-led clinic blending evidence-based medicine with cutting-edge wellness care.

Learn more:
www.fhhealth.com
www.pollinfertility.com
www.perennialcare.ca

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director of Finance to lead and scale our finance function and support the growth and expansion of the business. This role will serve as a key member of the leadership team, partnering closely with the executive team to drive financial performance, support growth initiatives, and shape the company’s long-term strategy. This role will also champion process improvements, automation, and the adoption of modern financial technologies, including AI-driven tools, to transform and elevate the finance function. The successful candidate will bring a forward-thinking, digitally savvy approach to optimizing workflows, enhancing reporting, and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.The ideal candidate is a designated CPA with strong analytical capabilities and a proven track record of building high-performing teams, optimizing financial operations, and enabling data-driven decision-making in a high-growth environment.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Leadership & Strategy
Act as a strategic advisor to the executive team on financial planning, growth, and expansion initiatives
Lead the development of long-term financial strategy aligned with corporate objectives
Translate business strategy into actionable financial plans and performance metrics
Support capital planning, fundraising, and investor relations as needed

Financial Planning & Analysis
Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling across all business units
Review financial results and identify key drivers, risks, and opportunities
Develop insights on profitability levers, cost optimization, and revenue growth
Establish KPIs and dashboards to enable real-time, data-driven decision-making
Partner with operations and clinical leaders to align financial and business strategies

Financial Reporting & Controls
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes
Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial statements in accordance with ASPE
Strengthen internal controls, policies, and financial governance frameworks
Lead audit processes, tax compliance, and coordination with external advisors
Accounting & Finance OperationsProvide oversight of day-to-day accounting operations, including A/R, A/P, payroll, inventory management and treasury
Drive process improvements, automation, and scalability across finance functions by leveraging modern technologies, including AI, to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and insight generation
Ensure compliance with regulatory, tax, and payroll requirements
Oversee financial operations across a multi-entity organizational structure

Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
Build and scale the finance function to support company growth and expansion
Promote cross-functional collaboration across departments
Act as a change agent to reimagine and modernize the finance function from the ground up, delivering strategic insights and building a nimble, high-impact team

Qualifications

CPA designation (required) in good standing
8–12+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including leadership roles
Experience in healthcare, technology, or high-growth environments
Strong background in financial planning & analysis, reporting, and operational finance
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives
Experience with ERP systems (preferably Odoo) and financial reporting tools
Deep understanding of ASPE and IFRS standards
Exceptional analytical, communication, and leadership skills
Hands-on, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment

Why Join FH Health (Perennial, Pollin and Wellness Haus)?

You’ll be joining a mission-driven, fast-growing organization that’s reimagining healthcare with innovation at its core. This is a unique opportunity to play a leadership role in shaping the financial future of a company making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Apply Now

We look forward to learning more about you. If you're a strategic finance leader passionate about driving growth and innovation in healthcare, we encourage you to apply.

FH Health is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact careteam@perennialcare.ca for assistance.We thank all applicants in advance for their interest in this position, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Director of Finance — Landmark Full-Service Resort, Atlantic Canada
$100,000 CAD base + bonus program | Relocation required | Retained search

The step you've been waiting for:

You're the Assistant Director of Finance at a full-service hotel. You already run the close. You already build the forecast. You already answer the questions the DOF gets credit for. What you don't have is the title, the seat on the Executive Committee, and the mandate that comes with them.
This is that seat.
Our client — a celebrated, century-old full-service resort in Atlantic Canada, operated by one of the country's largest hotel owner-operators — has retained Global Hospitality to find its next Director of Finance. We are not screening for a lateral move. We are looking for a strong #2 ready to be the #1.
The property
Two hundred–plus keys. Multiple food and beverage outlets. Championship golf. A full conference centre and spa. A four-season resort with real complexity — the kind of P&L that makes a finance leader, not the kind that babysits one.
Ownership is midway through a substantial capital reinvestment: guestrooms, restaurants, public spaces, and a significant new wellness amenity that extends the property's year-round demand. You will not inherit a static budget. You will help underwrite, monitor, and post-audit the spend that reshapes this asset.
The role
Reporting directly to the General Manager and serving on the Executive Committee, you will own:
All accounting functions and internal controls
— accuracy, timeliness, and compliance across the balance sheet
Financial statements, forecasts, and annual budgets
— prepared, defended, and delivered on time
Capital project finance
— ROI modelling, critical-path budget tracking, post-completion audits
Leadership of Accounting, Purchasing, Receiving, and IT
— hiring, coaching, and developing the team
Strategic partnership with department heads
— translating numbers into decisions for leaders who don't speak finance
Audit readiness, brand reporting, permits, licences, contracts, and insurance compliance

Credit and receivables management
, chairing the bi-weekly credit meeting

What we're looking for:

Progressive financial leadership in full-service hotels or resorts
— this is non-negotiable. Multi-outlet F&B, banquet, and rooms exposure matters here.
Current Assistant DOF, Controller, or Assistant Controller at a full-service property, with team leadership experience
Command of hotel accounting: reconciliations, AP, AR, payroll, budgeting, forecasting
Strong systems proficiency and genuine analytical range
Impeccable integrity, sound judgment, and the discretion the role demands
CPA is an asset, not a requirement

Our client's most successful hires in this seat have been strong second-in-commands who committed to two to three years
and used the role as the platform it is.

The life:

This is a rural, coastal posting — and that is the point.
Picture a walkable seaside town: locally owned restaurants, working harbours, a beach with the warmest swimming in the region, whale watching offshore, and a commute measured in minutes rather than lanes of traffic. It is a place where a professional salary buys a materially better standard of living than it does in a major market, and where the resort is the centre of community life rather than one building among thousands.
It is also genuinely remote. We are candid about that with every candidate, and you should be candid with yourself. The people who thrive here want it — the quiet, the seasons, the space, the community. If that describes you or your family, few opportunities in Canadian hospitality offer more.

Housing:
Company-owned townhouse rentals are available to help you land — two-bedroom units at $1,550–$1,750 per month. Convenient, close, and one less thing to solve during relocation.
Compensation
$100,000 CAD base salary plus participation in the bonus program, with a full benefits package.
Apply in confidence
Global Hospitality is retained on this search. All inquiries are handled in strict confidence, and no information is shared with our client without your explicit permission.

Joshua Platz | Global Hospitality Search Consultants
joshua@globalhospitality.com

From strategy to implementation. From ideas to impact.

The Ministry of Education is seeking a strategic and collaborative leader to serve as Director, Delivery Planning and Implementation Support. This is a unique leadership opportunity to shape how the ministry translates priorities into action by ensuring effective delivery planning, implementation, evaluation and results/performance management for complex, high-profile initiatives. Working at the intersection of policy, strategy and execution, you will lead a branch responsible for helping transform new ideas into practical actions and measurable outcomes while providing the evidence, insights and accountability frameworks needed to support continuous improvement. As a trusted partner to senior leaders across the ministry, you will play a pivotal role in advancing government priorities and driving meaningful change across Ontario's education system.

A career in the Ontario Public Service is driven by a passion for creating a stronger Ontario.

We foster a diverse and inclusive workplace where employees have the resources and opportunities, they need to be fulfilled and inspired to move Ontario forward.

About the job

Reporting to the Assistant Deputy Minister, Strategic Policy and Planning Division, you will:
lead a team responsible for delivery planning, implementation support, evaluation and results/performance management for key ministry priorities and initiatives
work across the ministry to translate policy decisions into practical implementation plans, measurable outcomes and sustainable change
provide strategic advice to executives on implementation risks, delivery performance, evaluation findings and opportunities for course correction
establish evidence-based approaches to evaluate the effectiveness of education initiatives and inform continuous improvement and decision making
build strong partnerships with ministry leaders, stakeholders and partners to support successful implementation of government priorities and delivery of measurable change
champion collaboration, engagement, equity, inclusion, accessibility, excellence and employee well-being within the branch, division and ministry

What you bring to the team

Executive Leadership

You are seasoned people leader with expertise in:
strategic and team leadership influencing people, promoting improved program development and delivery
supporting learning, capacity building and innovation around common purpose, while fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, equity and excellence
demonstrating and building resiliency and flexibility while leading and motivating high-performing teams in a fast-paced, highly visible demanding environment
guiding teams through change, complexity and evolving strategic priorities while promoting employee wellbeing and engagement

Relationship Management and Political Acuity

You are an effective communicator, and consensus builder with proven abilities in:
fostering collaborative internal and external relationships to promote a seamless integration of program design and service delivery
demonstrating executive presence, influence and political acuity while delivering strategic and confidential advice to senior leaders, and when collaborating with internal and external stakeholders
working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders to advance shared priorities and manage complex issues
managing complex, politically sensitive issues within the context of multiple interests, with high public profile and scrutiny

Job Knowledge

You are an influential program leader with proven abilities in:
program implementation, including designing and executing logic models, theories of change and delivery plans that translate policy decisions into measurable outcomes
program evaluation methods, strategies and frameworks to assess effectiveness, generate evidence and support continuous improvement
results and performance measurement and management, including the development of indicators, outcomes, reporting frameworks and accountability mechanisms
using data, evidence and analytical insights to assess results, identify risks and inform strategic course corrections

We are building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. Our hiring process is accessible, consistent with Ontario's Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005. For more information about accommodation during the hiring process please contact ExecutiveAccommodations@ontario.ca . All information discussed related to accommodation will be kept confidential.

Financial Reporting & Consolidations:

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital agency and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across: Digital Product Strategy & Innovation, Digital Marketing Services, Web & Mobile App Development, Data & AI, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Technology Modernization.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

Our Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will operate remotely in Canada OR be based out of either our Toronto, ON or Vancouver, BC office locations.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital's Data, AI & Cloud (DAIC) practice is the multidisciplinary engine behind enterprise AI, blending boutique innovation with the breadth of a global services portfolio to help organizations architect, scale, and secure their transformations. Spanning our full family of specialized capabilities, the DAIC practice delivers end-to-end solutions across AI Advisory, AI Solutions, Data & AI Platforms, and Cloud Transformation.

As a premier Google Cloud partner, our Cloud practice is at the forefront of helping enterprises adopt and scale on Google Cloud infrastructure: delivering complex engineering, deployment, and migration programs for some of the largest organizations in Canada and beyond.

The Director & Practice Lead, Data Engineering
will define and own the Data Engineering Practice along with its market positioning, P&L, talent, and the quality of work we deliver for clients. This role is for someone who has led data and AI practices before, understands how to turn messy enterprise data estates into strategic assets, and earns trust with C-suite executives through genuine expertise. You will shape how we help clients move from data ambition to durable, AI-ready infrastructure.

This Role Will Have Four Core Anchor Responsibilities

Strategy: Set the practice vision and align Data & AI capabilities to where enterprise demand is heading.
P&L: Own revenue targets, margin, and growth while being accountable for the practice's full commercial performance.
Talent & Culture: Build a practice where data-driven thinking, innovation, and engineering rigour are the baseline.
Client Impact: Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise CxOs navigating data strategy, AI adoption, and governance.

Responsibilities

Define the multi-year vision for the Data Engineering Practice, ensuring our technical capabilities are ahead of the curve for enterprise demand for Data & AI transformation.
Own the full P&L, including pipeline, pricing, delivery margin, and revenue growth, while reporting directly to executive leadership with clear commercial accountability.
Build and sustain senior relationships with Google Cloud partner teams and client executives to generate meaningful deal flow and expand strategic accounts.
Lead the practice's position on ethical AI and data democratisation while making principled, evidence-based bets on where advanced analytics and AI are creating real enterprise value.
Drive investment in reusable IP, data accelerators, and delivery assets that improve consistency, reduce time-to-value, and protect margins at scale.
Serve as a strategic advisor to client C-suite executives, helping them define data strategy, navigate AI adoption, and build the organisational capabilities to sustain it.
Set the standard for engineering and analytical excellence across the practice by hiring well, developing talent deliberately, and building teams that clients trust and return to.

Competencies

12+ years in data or AI consulting, including at least 3–5 years in a practice leadership or executive role, not just senior delivery or individual contribution.
Proven P&L ownership: Direct experience managing revenue, margin, and growth targets in a consulting or professional services context.
Data and AI ecosystem depth: Strong command of modern data architecture, AI, and ML trends, cloud-native data platforms, and enterprise data governance.
Executive communication: Able to advise, challenge, and build lasting trust with C-suite stakeholders on complex, ambiguous problems, not just present to them.
Business Development track record: Experience generating pipeline and closing complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, not just managing delivery once work is sold.
Talent leadership: Has hired, grown, and retained senior data engineering and consulting talent in a practice or delivery organisation.

Stacktics will rely on the Head of Data Systems with ownership of the Data Systems function including mentoring and support for our team of engineers, developers, marketing analysts and data scientists. The successful candidate will be expected to meet and exceed Stacktics' quality standards, while helping the organization rapidly expand into increasingly complex application development, data engineering, and related workflows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ownership of Stacktics' Data Systems Business Unit

Build and grow your team's capabilities and expertise to be truly platform-agnostic, ever-adapting based on opportunity and business direction
Lead thorough audits of clients'/prospects' Data Systems, and other associated platforms and technologies as applicable including performance and cloud cost-efficiency
Provide proactive recommendations, identifying areas of opportunity and/or improvement for clients based on their underlying business objectives and goals
Maintain continuous focus on work output quality and reliability, acting as the champion of customer satisfaction in a proactive manner and as the final escalation point for technical and delivery issues that cannot be resolved at the Technical Lead level
Act as Stacktics' primary Data Systems expert, ensuring to maintain and continuously grow personal expertise, and sharing information with other Stacktics team members, client stakeholders and prospects
Collaborate with, support, and work closely with cross-functional units to ensure efficient workflow, and realize cross-functional opportunities and enhancements
Maintain responsibility for the Business Unit's growth and success, continuously developing existing engagements, optimizing resourcing and prospecting
Be dedicated to the success and happiness of your team members, optimizing workflow, enabling their personal growth, and acting as a strong team leader overall

Instilling Development Best Practices and Skills/Procedures Advancement

Establishing, maintaining and evolving DevSecOps best practices and tools, and continuously keeping them aligned with current industry best practices and procedures
Understanding, implementing and automating security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation frameworks
Contributing to deployment tooling within the Stacktics team
Contributing to version control technology frameworks and creating/implementing working processes within the Data Systems team, with tools such as Git or SVN
Own and continuously improve the practice's AI coding standards, the AI coding constitution (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules), PR checklists, and slash commands keeping them current as tools, clients, and the team's needs evolve

Leading in the Software 3.0 Era

AI tools have changed how fast engineering work gets produced. Your job is to make sure that speed shows up as sounder architecture and higher-quality delivery — not just faster shipping of the same judgment gaps.
Recalibrate how the team scopes and estimates work as AI tooling changes what can actually be delivered in a sprint, so timelines and resourcing plans reflect real AI-era delivery speed
Set architecture and coding standards that assume engineers are using AI assistants daily — code review habits, eval frameworks, and quality gates sized to the failure modes of AI-assisted development, not just its speed
Continue evolving Stacktics' AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC) — our AI-native answer to SDLC — piloting new stages against real engagements and driving adoption across the team
Be an active daily user of AI coding assistants yourself, and bring that firsthand experience into how standards and review practices are set for the team
Lead Stacktics’ technical team members through the integration into Agentic AI-first working patterns, and beyond

Code Productization

Migrating the delivery of the most common/universally applicable solutions from custom projects to formally productized software solutions
Advocating for building repeatability, scalability and standardization into how the Stacktics Data Systems team approaches all work, in order to enable the future migration to productization as a general rule

Data Engineering-Specific Responsibilities

Participate in continuous delivery pipelines to fully automate deployment of the highly available cloud platform that supports multiple projects
Design and develop ETL workflows and datasets to be used in data visualization tools
Write complex SQL queries with multiple joins to automate and manipulate data extracts
Perform end to end Data Validation to maintain accuracy of data sets
Build tools for deployment, monitoring and operations
Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the development, test and production environments
Develop re-usable processes that can be leveraged and standardized for multiple instances
Prepare technical specifications and documentation for projects
Stay up to date on relevant technologies, plug into user groups, understand trends and opportunities to ensure we are using the best possible techniques and tools
Understand, implement, and automate security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation

Contribution to Corporate Strategy

Actively and proactively play a key role in steering Stacktics and affiliated companies, considering market developments, competitive maneuvers, unique opportunities, etc.
You will be expected to both bring new ideas to the table and assist other corporate leaders in vetting/developing concepts and tactics

new_jobs.title: Director of Finance
new_jobs.description:
Toronto or Waterloo, hybrid | Full-time | Reports to the CEO

Build the finance function at a fast-growing senior care technology company shipping hardware to 24 countries.

The Company

We went from a lab in Waterloo to 24 countries in five years. Our sensors detect falls and track sleep, health and wellness, with no cameras, wearables or pendants. Families get peace of mind. Older adults keep their independence. Our CTO, Dr. Yihong Qi, holds 680 patents, and the next few hundred get built here.

Why now

We are scaling. One of the largest deals in our history is in delivery, our consumer product launches in January, and we are preparing our next raise. Every one of those runs on numbers leadership can trust: a close that lands on time, a forecast that ties sales to inventory and cash, and books that hold up in diligence. This is the moment to bring in the leader who owns it.

The role

This is the senior finance role at Pontosense. You own the close, the forecast, controls and the numbers behind our next raise, across our entities in Canada and China. You work directly with the CEO and the leadership team, and you are in the room with investors. This is a builder role first and an operator role second. You set up how finance runs here, then you run it.

What You'll Own

A monthly close that is reliable and consolidated across Canada and China, landing by business day 10
A forecast the company actually runs on, with sales, inventory and cash tied together
Product costing that is right: landed cost, COGS and inventory planning for hardware built overseas
The raise: the model, the data room and investor reporting, with you in the room
Annual financials prepared and audited on time, and the relationships with our auditors and tax advisors
Controls that hold up across two countries: approvals, spend and intercompany
A seat at the leadership table

What Year One Looks Like

The books close on time every month, consolidated. The forecast is trusted, and inventory is planned, not guessed. Audited financials are current, and our next raise runs on numbers that hold up in diligence.

How We Work

Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.
Say it as it is. Kind and direct, at every level, including the CEO.
Real impact. There is more room to make a difference here than at a company ten times our size.
Do what you said. Trust is built on follow-through, and we return it with real ownership.
Hard, and worth it. What we build keeps someone's parent safe at home. Rest well, it's part of the job.

This is for you if

You'd rather own a problem than be assigned a task
You want the mission to matter and the pace to be real
You're happy to be the person who just fixes it

This isn't for you if

You want a playbook handed to you
You need a big team before you can move

You'll thrive here if

You are a CPA who started in audit, then grew with a product or technology company, with promotions along the way
You have owned the close and built the model yourself, not just reviewed them
You have run FP&A, not only the close: budgets, forecasts and the model leadership makes decisions on
You have worked with inventory, COGS and supply chain costing. Multi-entity or international consolidation is a strong plus
You have worked with investors, a board or lenders, or are ready to step into that
You explain the numbers plainly to people outside finance, and decide with incomplete information
You are as happy reconciling an account yourself as setting the strategy

You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

Where this goes

As we raise and scale, this role grows into leading a finance team of your own.

What You Get

A sensor for your parents, on us
Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
Fair pay, with the opportunity for equity
Impact decides your pay and your path, not tenure
Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
Health, dental and vision benefits

The details

Pay: $160,000 to $190,000 CAD base salary
This is a new role, created to grow the team, not a backfill
How we hire: typically an initial interview, a short case, and a final interview in person with our CEO and members of the team. We may adjust this depending on the role
We leverage AI tools in our hiring process, but prioritize human input and manual review

Our Commitment

At Pontosense, we are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and accessible to all. We value diversity and believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to make the necessary accommodations to ensure a fair and positive experience for all applicants.

We strive to provide accessible communication and technology for our employees and customers and always look for ways to improve. If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve accessibility in our workplace, please don't hesitate to contact us.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for open positions at our company.

new_jobs.title: Director of Finance
new_jobs.description:
Director of Finance — Landmark Full-Service Resort, Atlantic Canada
$100,000 CAD base + bonus program | Relocation required | Retained search

The step you've been waiting for:

You're the Assistant Director of Finance at a full-service hotel. You already run the close. You already build the forecast. You already answer the questions the DOF gets credit for. What you don't have is the title, the seat on the Executive Committee, and the mandate that comes with them.
This is that seat.
Our client — a celebrated, century-old full-service resort in Atlantic Canada, operated by one of the country's largest hotel owner-operators — has retained Global Hospitality to find its next Director of Finance. We are not screening for a lateral move. We are looking for a strong #2 ready to be the #1.
The property
Two hundred–plus keys. Multiple food and beverage outlets. Championship golf. A full conference centre and spa. A four-season resort with real complexity — the kind of P&L that makes a finance leader, not the kind that babysits one.
Ownership is midway through a substantial capital reinvestment: guestrooms, restaurants, public spaces, and a significant new wellness amenity that extends the property's year-round demand. You will not inherit a static budget. You will help underwrite, monitor, and post-audit the spend that reshapes this asset.
The role
Reporting directly to the General Manager and serving on the Executive Committee, you will own:
All accounting functions and internal controls
— accuracy, timeliness, and compliance across the balance sheet
Financial statements, forecasts, and annual budgets
— prepared, defended, and delivered on time
Capital project finance
— ROI modelling, critical-path budget tracking, post-completion audits
Leadership of Accounting, Purchasing, Receiving, and IT
— hiring, coaching, and developing the team
Strategic partnership with department heads
— translating numbers into decisions for leaders who don't speak finance
Audit readiness, brand reporting, permits, licences, contracts, and insurance compliance

Credit and receivables management
, chairing the bi-weekly credit meeting

What we're looking for:

Progressive financial leadership in full-service hotels or resorts
— this is non-negotiable. Multi-outlet F&B, banquet, and rooms exposure matters here.
Current Assistant DOF, Controller, or Assistant Controller at a full-service property, with team leadership experience
Command of hotel accounting: reconciliations, AP, AR, payroll, budgeting, forecasting
Strong systems proficiency and genuine analytical range
Impeccable integrity, sound judgment, and the discretion the role demands
CPA is an asset, not a requirement

Our client's most successful hires in this seat have been strong second-in-commands who committed to two to three years
and used the role as the platform it is.

The life:

This is a rural, coastal posting — and that is the point.
Picture a walkable seaside town: locally owned restaurants, working harbours, a beach with the warmest swimming in the region, whale watching offshore, and a commute measured in minutes rather than lanes of traffic. It is a place where a professional salary buys a materially better standard of living than it does in a major market, and where the resort is the centre of community life rather than one building among thousands.
It is also genuinely remote. We are candid about that with every candidate, and you should be candid with yourself. The people who thrive here want it — the quiet, the seasons, the space, the community. If that describes you or your family, few opportunities in Canadian hospitality offer more.

Housing:
Company-owned townhouse rentals are available to help you land — two-bedroom units at $1,550–$1,750 per month. Convenient, close, and one less thing to solve during relocation.
Compensation
$100,000 CAD base salary plus participation in the bonus program, with a full benefits package.
Apply in confidence
Global Hospitality is retained on this search. All inquiries are handled in strict confidence, and no information is shared with our client without your explicit permission.
